questions.question: 1. The connecting rod connects piston to:

explanations.a: The connecting rod transmits the piston’s linear motion to the crankshaft, converting it into rotational motion.

questions.question: 2. Which part controls air-fuel mixture entry?

explanations.b: Inlet valves regulate the entry of air-fuel mixture into the combustion chamber.

questions.question: 3. In diesel engines, fuel ignition occurs due to:

explanations.b: Diesel engines ignite fuel by compressing air to high temperatures, not using a spark plug.

questions.question: 4. The function of camshaft is to:

explanations.b: The camshaft ensures proper timing of valve opening and closing in the engine cycle.

questions.question: Virtual reality in engine study helps in:

explanations.b: VR allows students to study engine mechanisms safely, without real-world hazards or wear and tear.
